public_rationale: Anthropic's financing establishes outside investment, not industry-wide dependence on subsidies. Gamma's reported profitability and customer-funded growth challenge the universal wording. However, the accessible records do not establish comparable target-quarter cash coverage, and the claim supplies no accounting basis. The evidence does not justify either a supported or contradicted verdict under the money-claim rules.
limitations: The profitability counterexample is a company announcement, not a defined or audited profit measure.
This verdict does not endorse the assertion that every AI business requires subsidies.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Apart from hyperscaler GPU purchases from cashflow, the AI industry runs on subsidy, not revenue.
conditions: outside hyperscalers buying GPUs from cashflow

statement.excerpt: Outside of hyperscalers paying NVIDIA for GPUs out of cashflow, none of the AI industry is fueled by revenue. Every single part of the industry is fueled by some kind of subsidy.

from_speaker: Outside of hyperscalers paying NVIDIA for GPUs out of cashflow
none of the AI industry is fueled by revenue
Every single part of the industry is fueled by some kind of subsidy
our_interpretation: The surrounding discussion makes this a claim about dependence on outside funding to cover costs, not a claim that AI companies receive no customer revenue.
The universal wording includes AI application businesses as well as model developers and compute providers.
Use July–September 2025, the latest completed calendar quarter that could have been publicly reported before publication.
Receiving investment does not establish that a business needs investment to sustain its existing operations. Profit, operating cash flow and cash remaining after investment are different measures.
The speaker supplies no accounting basis for the industry-wide cost-coverage claim.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable financial records establish that every non-exempt part of the stated industry depended on outside financial support to cover ongoing costs during the target period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A non-exempt AI business demonstrably sustained its operations from customer receipts during the target period, without outside support covering a funding shortfall.
